row.title: REPO-CONFORM-2 stage 2 of 3: conformance reader and core-root files; agent entry stays AGENT-ENTRY-1's design
row.body: The structural-validator conformance reader (seed/scripts/repoconform.py) reads every machine-readable file against its own standard and reports an unreadable file as unmeasured. The core root carries the same identity files. The agent-instruction entry files keep the AGENT-ENTRY-1 design (#2686); the reader's agents_md validator accepts its Commands heading.
